title: Odd symmetrized acceptance probability
statement: Given a finite-seed sign tester and a bounded real-valued function on the sign cube, the odd symmetrized acceptance probability is the expectation, under the tester's seed law, of the odd symmetrized value of the check selected by each seed.
hypotheses_covered: A sign tester with a finite seed type and a probability law on its seeds
A bounded cube function with values in $[-1,1]
